name: python-scanner-class-move
body: `solution.component.python-module-identity` —implemented-by→ `rust.pyfrontend.scanner.Scanner.module_fqn_for`. The pylib decomposition (plan `apg-cleanup`, phase-04 task-5) splits the crate into cohesive modules, so the moved scanner units gain a module segment: the scanner lives in `src/pylib/scanner.rs` and its method renders `rust.pyfrontend.scanner.Scanner.module_fqn_for`. The preserved flat FQNs are the `rust.pyfrontend` module, `parse_args`, `run`, `Args`, `usage`, `read_target_set`, and `ensure_artifact_dir`.
